title: REQ · AdminApp passes approve, retry and reject handlers that call the client and reload
summary: Handlers call the matching client function then reload data
description: AdminApp currently renders ExecutionPanel with only execution and contributionCount. It must pass onApprove, onRetry and onReject. Each calls approveExecution, retryExecution or rejectExecution with the admin token and the execution id, then increments the reloads counter so the Round, contributions and execution are fetched again.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve is sent and the data is fetched again
Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/retry is sent and the data is fetched again
Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject is sent and the data is fetched again
definition_of_done: Handlers wired and verified by unit tests
